title: RGH-MMS Layered Bundle Config Fragment
description: Successor scope to schemas/repo-registry.schema.json (issue #327). Validates one bundle-config *fragment* -- the shape read from each of the four resolver layers (scripts/bundle_registry.py resolve_bundle_config): plugin per-platform defaults (platform-defaults/<platform>.json), the per-bundle entry under ~/.claude/rgh-mms.json's `bundles` map, a committed <target>/.claude/rgh-mms.json, and an uncommitted <target>/.claude/rgh-mms.local.json. Every top-level and nested field is optional -- unlike schemas/repo-registry.schema.json's single complete manifest, a layer fragment may set only the handful of keys it wants to override, so `required` is deliberately never used here. Field scope is narrower than the legacy registry schema: only what the rewired resolver consumers (skills/*/SKILL.md steps, scripts/transition-work-item-state.py, scripts/telemetry_publish.py::load_bundle_manifest) actually read. See repos/README.md 'Resolution order' for the four-layer precedence and .agent-metrics/contracts/i324_repo_offboarding.md for the design this schema implements.

bundle.description: Stable identifier, matching schemas/repo-registry.schema.json's bundle pattern. Optional in a layer file (the resolver already knows which bundle it is resolving); present mainly for a committed/local file to self-document which bundle it configures.

platform.description: Source host for the tracker/delivery mechanics. Determines which platform-defaults/<platform>.json layer-1 file the resolver loads. Defaults to github when no layer declares it.

review_checklist.description: Repo-specific review gates beyond the harness defaults.

local_command.description: Full local CI equivalent the implementor must pass before returning.

cli.description: CLI for scaffold/settle, e.g. agent-metrics contract.

parent_issue_query.description: Optional GitHub parent-issue worklist template. Token: {parent}.

iteration_path.description: ADO iteration path for sprint/iteration-scoped delivery.

work_item_wiql.description: ADO WIQL or query id for open work items in scope.

pr_body_closes.description: PR body closing-issue template, e.g. Closes #{issue}.

milestone_branch_pattern.description: Tracking branch naming for integration_mode=milestone-aggregate. Tokens: {milestone}, {bundle}, {parent}.

agent_may_merge.description: When true, supervisor may merge issue PRs into the milestone tracking branch (milestone-aggregate only).

work_item_states.description: Tracker state names to transition a work item through as the loop progresses.

in_progress.description: State to set when a branch is cut for the work item.

done.description: State to set once the work item's issue PR merges into the integration base.

ado.description: Minimal ADO tracker addressing needed by scripts/transition-work-item-state.py. Not the full schemas/repo-registry.schema.json ado block (no repo/default_branch/remote_url here -- those are git-hosting metadata this resolver's consumers do not read).

grafana_cloud.description: Grafana Cloud instance and credential resolution for telemetry publication (see instrumentation/grafana-cloud.md and policy/security.md). All fields optional; unset resolves to scripts/telemetry_publish.py's harness-wide DEFAULT_* constants. This block belongs in the operator-local ~/.claude/rgh-mms.json layer, not a committed <target>/.claude/rgh-mms.json -- see repos/README.md 'Resolution order' for why credential-shaped fields should not be committed into an arbitrary product repo.

instance_url.description: Override for the harness-wide default Grafana Cloud stack hostname.

credential.description: Env var the session must have set, e.g. GRAFANA_CLOUD_TOKEN.

loki.description: Grafana Cloud Loki push target for loop-event log lines and its own distinct credential. See instrumentation/grafana-cloud.md and policy/security.md.

endpoint.description: Override for the harness-wide default Loki push endpoint.

credential.description: Env var the session must have set, e.g. GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOKI_TOKEN.

keychain_item.description: macOS Keychain service name for the Loki credential.

push_enabled.description: Set to false to disable the Loki write-through push while keeping local JSONL recording.
